The piece in detail

Full description & specifications

About this piece

A plain-formulated 100 g solid aloe vera soap bar listing aloe vera extract, niacinamide, tea tree oil, vitamin E, panthenol (vitamin B5), and vegetable oil base. Supplied in single or multi-bar pack options for home bathroom rotation.

Supplier artwork containing therapeutic or skin-tone promises is intentionally withheld from this page. OPAR keeps only verified pack metrics—net weight, shelf-life window, period after opening, and SKU reference—visible above the fold.

Construction sample pricing is set across pack sizes of 1, 3, and 5 so variant price switching and cart line calculation can be verified prior to live supplier sourcing.

Care & handling

Store away from standing water on a dry soap rest after washing. Observe the supplier-stated 12-month period after opening.

Before you decide

Delivery, returns and use

Delivery and fulfilment

The supplier listing showed free standard shipping to the United Kingdom with a 19–24 November window when read on 6 November 2026. OPAR confirms your destination, charge and estimate on the invoice. Shipping policy

Returns and support

Returns follow OPAR's published returns policy. The supplier advertises 90-day free returns; that is the supplier's term, not OPAR's. Returns policy

Directions and product information

Read the current pack directions, full ingredient list and warnings before use. This page makes no treatment, prevention or skin-tone claim. Payment & invoicing

Common questions

Questions about this piece

Why does this page show a botanical mount instead of a supplier photo?

The supplier's photograph overlays unverified cosmetic-medicinal text on the wrapper. OPAR withholds that image and waits for clean photography.

Are Pack of 3 and Pack of 5 prices confirmed for wholesale?

No. The figures displayed are dummy construction-sample rates used to test variant switching and checkout receipts before sourcing margins are confirmed.

Is a full UK Responsible Person verified for this item?

Not yet. The supplier names an EU address only; UK Responsible Person details and ordered INCI confirmation stay tracked under compliance checks.

Provenance & verification

Disclosures & evidence ledger

0 of 9 checks verified · review ledger

The supplier makes claims OPAR will not repeat. Without a full ingredient list, a safety report, and a UK responsible person, this bar cannot be sold.

  • not-provided Full INCI ingredient list The listing names niacinamide, tea tree oil, vitamin E, vitamin B5, aloe vera and plant oils. That is a marketing summary, not an ordered INCI list.
  • not-provided Cosmetic product safety report The supplier names an EU responsible person, which implies a file exists. OPAR has not seen it.
  • not-provided Label and batch coding PAO of 12 months and shelf life of 36 months are stated. The physical label has not been inspected.
  • not-provided Claim substantiation Supplier claims include anti-acne and brightening. Neither will be published.
  • not-provided Third-party laboratory report No report held for composition, microbiology, or heavy metals.
  • not-provided UK responsible person Only an EU appointment is stated. Selling into Great Britain needs a UK-based responsible person.
  • pending Manufacturer identity and country Supplier states Yihai boshi (Guangzhou) Trading Co., Ltd, Guangdong, China. Not independently checked.
  • not-provided Permission to use supplier photographs Image is used in a local mockup only.
  • not-provided Resale permission and order limits Listing states a maximum of one piece per shopper at the displayed price. Resale terms unknown.
What OPAR will not claim & review audit

Excluded supplier wording and unverified claims:

  • Treats or prevents acne
  • Reduces spots or breakouts
  • Brightens, whitens, or evens skin tone
  • Controls oil
  • Inhibits melanin production
  • Clinically proven
  • Dermatologist tested
  • Handmade
  • Natural or chemical-free
